svg.title: Alvaro "Pau" Reis, AI engineer
svg.desc: Alvaro "Pau" Reis, AI engineer in Broward County, Florida. I build multi-tenant products end to end. Agents write code. Tests decide what ships. No agent grades its own work. Broken rules become automatic checks.

g.text: I build multi-tenant products end to end.
Agents write code. Tests decide what ships.
No agent grades its own work.
nothing ships until it is proven
my commits, with agents riding the wave
